novel_features.name: Cross-domain spend/order history
novel_features.description: See total spend and order counts across Food and Instamart in one view, even though Swiggy keeps them completely separate. Dineout has no orders-list tool and is not included.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining locally-cached order/booking rows from three independently-siloed MCP servers that share no data on Swiggy's side.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when the user asks about overall Swiggy spend or activity rather than a single domain's orders.

novel_features.name: Unified UPI payment wait
novel_features.description: Block until a UPI payment resolves instead of hand-rolling a polling loop yourself. Not for COD orders — check payment status once and proceed instead.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps the documented long-poll `check_payment_status` contract (server holds ~19s) with backoff and a terminal-state exit, shared across all three servers.
novel_features.example: swiggy-pp-cli pay wait --paas-id paas_123 --order-id ord_01HXYZ --domain food --max-wait 5s
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this immediately after any UPI place-order/checkout/book-table call; do not poll check-payment-status manually.

novel_features.name: Safe retry after failed order placement
novel_features.description: Check whether a food or grocery order actually went through before retrying a failed placement.
novel_features.rationale: `place_food_order`/`checkout` are explicitly documented as not idempotent; this command reconciles against real order history so retries never risk a duplicate order.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before ever re-issuing place-food-order or checkout after a 5xx or timeout.

novel_features.name: Auth/session health check
novel_features.description: See at a glance whether your Swiggy login is still valid and which domain sessions are active.
novel_features.rationale: Reads the CLI's own stored OAuth token expiry and per-domain MCP session cache — no other Swiggy tool exposes this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check this before starting a multi-step order flow to avoid a mid-flow 401.

narrative.headline: Every Swiggy Builders Club tool, one persistent OAuth session, and a local order history no Swiggy surface shows you.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps all 51 official Swiggy MCP tools across Food, Instamart, and Dineout into one CLI that respects Swiggy's own session-reuse rules instead of tripping rate limits. Adds cross-domain spend history, a safe-retry guard for non-idempotent order placement,.
narrative.auth_narrative: Swiggy Builders Club uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration — no API key. Run `swiggy-pp-cli auth login` to open a browser, log in with your phone number and OTP on Swiggy's own consent screen, and the CLI stores the resulting 5-day access token. There is no refresh token in v1.0; re-run `auth login` when it expires.

quickstart.comment: Health check that works without auth — confirms the binary and config are set up before logging in.
Complete the OAuth 2.1 PKCE browser login (phone + OTP) once; the CLI persists the session.
First real call — confirms the session works and gives you an addressId for search.
Search restaurants near a saved address.
See cross-domain (Food + Instamart) spend once you have some order history.

troubleshoots.fix: Run `swiggy-pp-cli auth login` again — access tokens expire after 5 days and v1.0 has no refresh token.

troubleshoots.symptom: place-food-order failed with a 5xx and you're unsure if it placed
troubleshoots.fix: Run `swiggy-pp-cli order verify-before-retry` before retrying — place-food-order is not idempotent.
Stop retrying immediately; the CLI reuses one persistent session per domain by design, but concurrent multi-domain commands can still add up — space out calls across food/instamart/dineout.
Run `swiggy-pp-cli pay wait --paas-id paas_123 --order-id ord_01HXYZ --domain food` (swap --domain for instamart/dineout as needed) to long-poll to a terminal state instead of polling manually.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for scripted or agent-driven Swiggy commerce flows: searching restaurants/products, managing carts, placing orders, booking tables, and tracking deliveries/bookings across Food, Instamart, and Dineout. Good for building or debugging an agent on top of Swiggy Builders Club before wiring a full agent framework, or for personal automation of routine orders.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for Swiggy's consumer web/app features outside the Builders Club MCP surface (e.g. loyalty program management, customer support chat).
Do not use this CLI for production-scale/multi-tenant traffic without applying for production access at mcp.swiggy.com/builders/access — this CLI targets a single authenticated user's own account.
Do not use this CLI to exceed the ₹1000 Food cart cap or bypass Swiggy's documented rate limits.

recipes.title: Order food end-to-end
recipes.command: swiggy-pp-cli food search-restaurants --address-id addr_01HXYZ --query biryani && swiggy-pp-cli food get-restaurant-menu --address-id addr_01HXYZ --restaurant-id r_123 --select restaurantId,items.id,items.name,items.price
recipes.explanation: Search then narrow a large menu payload down to just the fields needed to build a cart.

recipes.title: Safe retry after a failed order
recipes.command: swiggy-pp-cli order verify-before-retry --domain food --address-id addr_01HXYZ --restaurant-id r_123 --amount 450
recipes.explanation: Confirms whether a non-idempotent place-food-order call actually succeeded before retrying.

recipes.title: Check spend across Food and Instamart
recipes.explanation: Cross-domain aggregation (Food + Instamart; Dineout has no orders-list tool) with a narrowed agent-friendly field selection. --address-id is required to include Food.
